"The genealogy of Jesus Christ was traced for several generations in the Gospel of Matthew, but the passage has a number of difficulties. The second part is:

"No longer bound by my earthly responsibilities, I was free to explore the cathedral without any constraints. I felt as though I had been given a glimpse into another world, a world where I was not limited by the constraints of my waking life. I was filled with a sense of awe and reverence, and I knew that I would never forget this experience. As I walked through the cathedral, I felt as if I was being guided by a higher power, a force that was both within me and beyond me. I was filled with a deep sense of peace and contentment, and I knew that I was exactly where I was meant to be. For the first time in my life, I felt truly free—no longer bound by the expectations and responsibilities of my waking life. I was free to be myself, free to explore the depths of my soul, and free to connect with the divine in a way that I had never thought possible. I felt as if I had been given a great gift, and I was determined to cherish and nurture this newfound connection for the rest of my life."
